reason: Does not fit bank 4's room in builds the project and the proof gate need. Applied verbatim to a clean copy of the tree: the shipping and gameplay builds and DEBUG_LIVES assemble, but DEBUG_FULLREDRAW (the full-redraw oracle that passlock, worldrun and kcguard compare against) fails with 'src/main.6502:151: error: bank 4 overruns the renderer's workspace by 38', and SKY_HELI=0 (decision 36's build, a documented build flag) fails 'by 36'. Unmodified copies of both assemble. The +45 bytes come from keeping the old src5..src7 tail as unreachable code. The logic itself checks out: hist0=&B800 and hist1=&B900, so TXA/ORA #&B8 gives the slot's high byte; the reads at hist+7-k+X are the same addresses as before; 25 groups end at X=0; C is 0 at the loop top; the IRQ never touches &85/&86; the caller (ren_plot_lives) reads no registers or flags. Freeing room by deleting the dead tail would be a different candidate.
